gloss_en: Python script that dumps IFC parameters to one Excel per file works with Revit IFC exporter 22.1 but breaks with 22.6; COBie and custom parameters come out differently.
title_original: Assistance Required for Extracting Data from IFC Files Exported with Different Versions of Revit's IFC Exporter
question_paraphrase: I loop over all IFC in a folder and write an Excel sheet per file with chosen entity parameters. Exporter 22.1 works, 22.6 changes the structure and COBie/custom properties are missed.
phrasing_notes: polite greeting 'Hi Everyone!', long narrative, no code snippet in first paragraph
answer_summary: Use ifcopenshell.util.element.get_psets() instead of raw traversal, or IfcCSV with wildcard pset names.

gloss_en: How do I open the .ifcsqlite files produced by the Ifc2Sql patch? Normal IFC open does not work.
question_paraphrase: I read about IFC stored as SQLite and MySQL but cannot open the output of the ifc2sql patch. Can it be opened with standard UI open, imported, linked or via script?
phrasing_notes: lowercase title, short questions chained, 'or' alternatives
answer_summary: Open with any SQL explorer for browsing; loading into Blender needs specific conversion settings supported by the project.

gloss_en: A 2 GB federated 4D IFC runs out of RAM on 16 GB when opened; what strategies exist to treat IFC as a queryable database?
title_original: Strategies on dealing with large IFC datasets
question_paraphrase: IFC from Synchro with verbose task info is 2 GB; ifcopenshell.open exhausts 16 GB. Is there another serialisation, preprocessor for lazy loading, or storage tech?
phrasing_notes: opens as discussion starter, proposes several ideas
answer_summary: Lazy parsing helps only if few instances are accessed; consider database-backed storage or streaming approaches.

gloss_en: Ifc2Sql patch fails when exporting the Dormitory sample to sqlite, and docs do not say whether the output should be a file name or a folder.
title_original: Ifc2Sql Patch (Bonsai + IOS) failing to export
question_paraphrase: Select Ifc2Sql patch on the Dormitory project, set output folder, press patch, it errors. Unclear if I give a filename, .db or .sqlite.
phrasing_notes: structured bug template with numbered steps and a NB: remark
answer_summary: Maintainer shipped a fix in an updated build; docs gap on output path noted.

gloss_en: Wants a simple IFC-to-CSV BoQ export that keeps the link between each BoQ row and the IFC element GUIDs; follow-up asks how to group identical elements by floor and room type.
title_original: IFC CSV BoQ Export with Element Linking
question_paraphrase: Tender and cost work runs on spreadsheets; I need rows traceable to IFC elements, e.g. ventilators FAN-01..03 per room, and summarise equal elements by floor.
phrasing_notes: bulleted pitch with symbols, later informal 'I need solution for this'
answer_summary: Use Spreadsheet Import/Export and group/sum by an aggregator property; link to cost items via code or GUID.

gloss_en: IfcCsv export should allow comma as decimal separator because Polish Excel treats dot values as text.
question_paraphrase: In Poland Excel regional settings follow the interface language, so dotted numbers become text; today I fix types in Power Query. XLSX and ODS export fine.
answer_summary: Agreed; also add CSV dialects (excel, excel_tab, unix).

gloss_en: Bill of Quantities CSV export adds useless columns (Id, Hierarchy, Index, Children), lacks units and decimal control, so users copy-paste from the browser view into a spreadsheet.
question_paraphrase: Browser view has no PDF/print export; CSV export has junk columns, no unit column, no decimal setting; I just ctrl+C into Excel.
phrasing_notes: bullet points, screenshots of headers, ends with 'thank you'
answer_summary: Confirmed by another user: cost and totals show in UI but not in CSV; print-to-PDF suggested from browser.

gloss_en: ifcpatch Ifc2Sql raises sqlite3 IntegrityError UNIQUE constraint on IfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef.ifc_id; custom database filename produces a corrupt file in 0.8.2.
title_original: possible bug in ifcpatch v 0.8.2 for Ifc2Sql recipe
question_paraphrase: Writing sqlite via ifcpatch.execute fails with UNIQUE constraint; later found writing into existing table was cause, but custom filename now yields a corrupt file plus default database.sqlite.
answer_summary: First error was loading into an already populated table; filename regression reported separately.

gloss_en: Excluding the GlobalId column then using 'preserve existing' on a second export to ODS adds extra null values.
title_original: If you exclude the GlobalId column, and then 'preserve existing' on a 2nd export, it adds some additional null values.
question_paraphrase: Door schedule round trip: second export with preserve existing inserts null rows when GlobalId column is excluded; only screenshots given.
phrasing_notes: title is the whole sentence; mostly screenshots
answer_summary: Maintainer could not reproduce with XLSX and asked for tests.

gloss_en: Literal \n characters show up in ODS exports of text; remove them or render real newlines.
question_paraphrase: Material and surface style names carry escaped newlines that look wrong in ODS; a workaround script replaces them but errors appear for some text literals.
answer_summary: Maintainer suspected a hidden bug with null literals; workaround via script.

gloss_en: Wants Excel-like formulas inside Bonsai spreadsheet capability so custom properties can be computed from other properties, e.g. depth relative to georeferenced height.
question_paraphrase: Add/subtract/multiply/divide with chained formulas on properties and attributes, also using georeferenced Z, to fill custom properties.
phrasing_notes: 'Couple of wishes' list, enthusiastic, 'would be awesome'
answer_summary: Open feature request.

gloss_en: Bonsai COBie export lacks 5 of the 20 standard tabs (Instruction, Impact, Coordinate, Issue, PickLists) compared with BIMvision.
title_original: COBie export - missing Instruction, Impact, Coordinate, Issue, PickLists tabs
question_paraphrase: Compared a COBie xlsx from BIMvision with one from Bonsai: five tabs missing, which is a COBie nonconformity though other 15 tabs are filled.
phrasing_notes: states standard conformity argument with evidence
answer_summary: Maintainers asked the COBie owner to look.

gloss_en: COBie systems tab is empty although Bonsai shows 214 systems in its Systems panel.
question_paraphrase: Exporting COBie spreadsheet leaves Systems empty while Bonsai identifies 214; offers to share IFC.
answer_summary: Maintainer asked which software produced the spreadsheet; ownership of bug unclear.

gloss_en: Exported a cost schedule CSV from a course file and re-importing it throws an error.
question_paraphrase: While following a 5D costing crash course I imported, exported and re-imported the cost CSV and got an error with a long system dump.
phrasing_notes: mentions the paid course by name; pasted debug block
answer_summary: Maintainer asked for the IFC and CSV to reproduce.

gloss_en: Benchmark of memory-efficient ways to read IFC (streaming, sqlite, rocksdb) for tasks like listing all window GUIDs on a 300 MB model.
question_paraphrase: Shows modes compared to plain SPF on a near 300 MB model for the task of printing all IfcWindow GUIDs.
answer_summary: RocksDB and lark streaming reduce memory vs full SPF load.

gloss_en: Ifc2Sql with sql_type=mysql fails with 'Column count doesn't match value count at row 1' even for a simple wall/window model.
question_paraphrase: Patcher(sql_type='mysql', database, full_schema=True) throws MySQL error 1136 in insert_data.
answer_summary: Cause was a missing inverses column in MySQL table creation, fixed on the 0.8 line.

gloss_en: Wants BCF issues exported to a spreadsheet like the Excel output of Solibri.
question_paraphrase: Wishlist: few tools do this; something like Solibri's Excel issue output.
answer_summary: Agreed as nice; priority depends on need.

gloss_en: Selecting multiple IFC files in the Facility Management tab and exporting to Excel throws an error, while ODS works.
question_paraphrase: Multiple example IFCs from a public CC BY-SA set exported to Excel produce an error log; ODS is fine.
answer_summary: Open bug report.

gloss_en: After a performance fix to ExtractElements the output IFC is 23.7% smaller, 195 walls look different, 4 lost presentation layers and 26 spatial BaseQuantities are disconnected.
title_original: ExtractElements: Smaller model and several differences between builds
question_paraphrase: Compared two builds on 2,004 walls: same GUIDs and geometry but differences in styles, layers and quantities found via validation.
answer_summary: Maintainers confirmed two of four were real, including lost BaseQuantity relationships.

gloss_en: Wants link_ifc to pull a synced IFC instead of creating an sqlite cache, because external style assignments from a core and shell model do not show in the tenant model.
title_original: Would it be possible to have an option where bim.link_ifc() was able to pull in a synced .blend/.ifc file
question_paraphrase: Linking core and shell into tenant model builds a sqlite database and loses external style assignments.
phrasing_notes: very long title that is the whole question
answer_summary: Open request.

gloss_en: Experiment storing full IFC in SQLite/MySQL for lower memory, lazy loading and SQL queries by non-programmers; benchmarks load time vs SPF.
title_original: IFC stored as SQLite and MySQL
question_paraphrase: Goals: represent all IFC, reduce memory, use free SQL dialects, store geometry blobs, allow network access; JSON columns for lists; load time cut from 28s to 4.6s.
answer_summary: Community discussed concurrency, SpatiaLite/GeoPackage patterns, German object-relational paper.

gloss_en: How to get a flat table of entity, property set, attribute and value type for IFC2x3 and IFC4 for Power BI; the spec is hard to extract.
question_paraphrase: Need flat entity/pset/attribute listing from the official spec; JSON of IFC4.3 is too big for BI tool; later dropped the Power BI IFC navigator.
phrasing_notes: short ask, later admits giving up
answer_summary: Spreadsheet conversions of schemas, DDS schema navigator, pointer to OSArch CSV/JSON discussion.

gloss_en: A sustainability consultant who measures materials by hand in a PDF reader for LCA wants free software that lists IFC quantities better than Revit.
title_original: Which Software to create lists of quantities of the used building materials
question_paraphrase: Measuring in PDF for life cycle assessment; want IFC takeoff tool, free if possible.
answer_summary: Solibri exports to Excel; enable base quantities and material psets in Revit; check MVD and units; IfcOpenShell/BlenderBIM or CYPE as options.

gloss_en: Open-source Python tool builds a reinforced concrete BOQ from IFC with base quantity, pset and geometric fallback tiers and shows quantity provenance; asks for test files for free Excel/PDF BOQ.
title_original: Free IFC Concrete BOQ, looking for test files and honest feedback
question_paraphrase: Three-tier quantity source; outputs Excel and PDF; supports IFC2x3, IFC4, IFC4x3; wants honest accuracy feedback.
answer_summary: No replies on page.

gloss_en: Compares six strategies for storing IFC in relational DB; favours one entity table plus attribute tables per base type with triggers.
question_paraphrase: Blob, text, table per entity, table per inheritance step, two tables, entity table plus typed attribute tables; referential integrity and SELECT types.
answer_summary: Debate about hybrid graph/JSON stores, SELECT-type limits, IfcDoc SQL export.

gloss_en: Has a Solibri ITO/QTO xlsx with element GUIDs validated by IDS-like rules, wants to create BCF issues per problem from GUID list without loading IFC elements.
question_paraphrase: Use bcf.v3 to create one issue per missing/wrong property; library demands IFC instances; any standard way to push only GUIDs?
answer_summary: No replies shown.

gloss_en: Student rebuilds IFC from SQLite via patch; validator reports violations on IfcSite even though the file looks the same as the original.
question_paraphrase: Stored special types as TEXT in SQLite; validator flags normative rule violations; export or storage problem?
answer_summary: Found a loop error that dropped data; rerun fixed it.

gloss_en: Developer shares an in-browser SQLite BIM modeller, 4D/5D viewer and ERP orders with bill of materials; IFC/SQLite/BCF export.
question_paraphrase: Event-sourced SQLite WASM modeller, BOM tree, Git-like branching, 122k-element model, schedule import.
answer_summary: Self-reported dev log.

gloss_en: Asks for experience optimising the IFC to GIS workflow of geometry and information.
question_paraphrase: Looking for experiences moving IFC to GIS systems.
answer_summary: Esri learning path, OGC IFC-GML paper, TU Delft GeoBIM, IFC-to-GeoJSON for QGIS; georeferencing essential.

gloss_en: How to export marked Z coordinates as a CSV attribute from Bonsai 0.8.4; no docs about exporting geometric coordinates.
question_paraphrase: Spreadsheet export does not seem to offer computed coordinates.
answer_summary: Computed values likely unavailable; use Python on saved IFC.

gloss_en: BIM QTOs often disagree with schedules and cost estimates; wants software to overlay and compare quantities and send inconsistencies to designers or estimators.
question_paraphrase: Cost rows are not one-to-one with model quantities (installation rows skipped, others split); wants not to build in-house.
phrasing_notes: detailed, mentions what is already built
answer_summary: A QS recommends defining a cross-reference ID, then Power Query or pandas.

gloss_en: Developer in India building a MasterFormat-based cost estimation tool asks how to extract element details from IFC to match against its database.
title_original: Help regarding extracting/ importing data from IFC to Estimation software
question_paraphrase: No software dev background; need dimensions, material, colour, model from IFC to map to property groups.
answer_summary: Use XBIM for C#; IfcOpenShell for Python; IFC route works across BIM tools.

gloss_en: Prototype of ifcSQL storing IFC from many projects in one SQL DB with schemas, triggers and STEP export procedure.
title_original: Store, modify and retrieve ifc-data with ifcSQL
question_paraphrase: Walkthrough with a minimal IfcProject: global entity table, typed attribute tables, trigger rejecting wrong types.
answer_summary: Discussion on performance, BIMserver key-value store, HDF5 option.

gloss_en: Announcement of C# tools (IfcSharp) for storing IFC models in files and relational databases as proof of concept.
question_paraphrase: Proof-of-concept apps with shared API library; may not handle every IFC.
answer_summary: One positive reply.

gloss_en: Demo where clicking an IFC element in a browser viewer fetches its properties, generates semantic tags with AI and matches them to a structured defect-report knowledge base for pre-construction review.
title_original: 施工前検討会で過去の不具合事例を参照する：IFC部位情報×構造化ナレッジRAGのデモ
question_paraphrase: クリックした部材のプロパティからAIがタグを生成し、過去の不具合事例を検索して原因と対策を表示する。
phrasing_notes: Japanese tech-blog tone, demo-oriented title with colon
answer_summary: Properties to tags to RAG matching.

gloss_en: Argues IFC alone carries enough info for 4D, 5D, 7D and ERP dimensions without AI, with a browser tool converting IFC to SQLite via WebAssembly.
title_original: Your IFC is all you need
question_paraphrase: IFC schema is rich enough to derive project dimensions; browser search tool; commenter notes in-browser SQLite conversion.
answer_summary: Demo video linked.

gloss_en: Give me wall net side area by storey and type as a table I can paste in Excel
prompt: pull all IfcWall, group by storey and type name, sum NetSideArea from Qto_WallBaseQuantities, output csv/table. flag walls with no quantities
expected_behavior: Traverse walls, resolve storey via containment, read Qto_WallBaseQuantities.NetSideArea, aggregate per storey+type, report missing quantity sets, emit CSV/table.

gloss_en: Dump every property of all doors into one flat sheet, column per pset.prop
prompt: need a flat dump of all IfcDoor with every pset property as a column (Pset_DoorCommon.FireRating etc), plus GlobalId and level. csv is fine
expected_behavior: Collect doors, merge get_psets, union keys as columns, include GlobalId and storey, write CSV, mention empty columns and Revit-specific psets.

gloss_en: Export the model to sqlite and show a query that counts elements per class
prompt: convert this ifc to sqlite and then run a query for count of elements by ifc class, biggest first
expected_behavior: Run an Ifc2Sql-style export (or in-memory equivalent), run GROUP BY class COUNT, show results and note output path.

gloss_en: My Excel totals don't match what you read from the model for slabs, find out why
prompt: slab volumes in my cost sheet are 8% off the model. which slabs have no Qto or odd units?
expected_behavior: Compute slab volumes from Qto and geometry, compare with provided sheet if loaded, list slabs lacking quantities, unit mismatches, openings/overlaps, suggest cross-ref by GlobalId.

gloss_en: Make a dataset for Power BI: element count and missing FireRating by level
prompt: i want a table per level with element count and how many are missing FireRating so i can chart it in power bi
expected_behavior: Aggregate by storey the count of elements and those lacking Pset_*Common.FireRating, output tidy CSV with consistent columns, mention load into Power BI.

gloss_en: How would you load this IFC into neo4j, what nodes and edges
prompt: if i wanted this model in neo4j what would the nodes and relationships be? show cypher for spatial structure
expected_behavior: Explain mapping IfcRoot to nodes and IfcRel* to relationships, give Cypher for Project-Site-Building-Storey-Element, caveats on property modelling, offer to generate CSV.

gloss_en: Convert model to RDF and give a SPARQL to find windows on level 2
prompt: convert to ifcOWL / RDF turtle and write a sparql to find all IfcWindow in storey named Level 2
expected_behavior: Convert or describe conversion, caveats about ifcOWL list structure, write SPARQL through containment, report counts.

gloss_en: Export columns by floor with length volume and type into a spreadsheet
prompt: выгрузи в таблицу все колонны по этажам: тип, длина, объём, маркa. csv ок. если объёма нет — отметь
expected_behavior: Filter IfcColumn, group by storey, take Qto_ColumnBaseQuantities and type parameters, flag missing volumes, output CSV.

gloss_en: Summarise concrete volume by floor and component type for a cost sheet
prompt: 帮我按楼层统计混凝土构件的体积，梁板柱分开，导出成excel能用的表
expected_behavior: Select beams, slabs, columns, filter by concrete material, sum volumes per storey and class, export a table, note missing quantities.

gloss_en: Which elements lack classification code and create a CSV for the dashboard
prompt: dime que elementos no tienen clasificación asignada y sácame un csv por nivel para el dashboard
expected_behavior: Find elements without IfcClassificationReference, group by level and class, output CSV, summarise counts.

gloss_en: Extract an equipment list with tag, space and manufacturer for FM handover
prompt: preciso da lista de equipamentos com tag, ambiente e fabricante pra entrega do FM, em planilha
expected_behavior: List mechanical/electrical equipment with Tag, containing space and manufacturer from psets, flag missing manufacturer, output spreadsheet-ready table.

gloss_en: Which walls lack FireRating and export them with GUID
prompt: welche Wände haben keine Feuerwiderstandsklasse? Liste mit GUID und Geschoss raus als csv, Semikolon als Trenner bitte
expected_behavior: Find walls without Pset_WallCommon.FireRating, output GUID and storey as semicolon-delimited CSV with German-locale decimals.

gloss_en: Total area of walls per room for a quantity table
prompt: donne moi les surfaces de murs par pièce, dans un tableau, avec les murs sans pièce à part
expected_behavior: Associate walls to spaces via boundaries/containment, sum areas per space, list orphan walls separately.

gloss_en: List main beams by level with section and span for pre-construction review
prompt: 大梁を階ごとに一覧にして、断面とスパンと材料も出して。施工前検討会で使いたい
expected_behavior: List IfcBeam by level with profile, length/span and material, output table, state missing values.

gloss_en: Make an Excel-ready table of room areas by floor
prompt: 층별 실(Space) 면적 엑셀로 쓸 수 있게 표로 뽑아줘. 면적 없는 방은 표시
expected_behavior: List IfcSpace by storey with name, number and net floor area, flag missing area, output table.

gloss_en: Why do exported decimals appear as text in my Excel
prompt: quando esporto in csv i decimali con il punto diventano testo in excel italiano, come lo sistemo?
expected_behavior: Explain locale mismatch, suggest comma decimal and semicolon delimiter or Power Query type change.

gloss_en: Count elements per class and list ones with no property sets
prompt: count elements per ifc class and list the ones that have zero psets - might be junk exports
expected_behavior: Enumerate IfcProduct classes with counts, find elements with no property sets, return summary and sample GUIDs.
